function.name: request_callback
function.description: Book a callback from a department that is closed or busy. Only call after the caller has agreed to be called back and you have repeated their number back to them.

phone.description: Best number to call back, digits only, as the caller confirmed it

reason.description: Short, non-clinical reason for the callback

consent_to_callback.description: True only if the caller clearly agreed to be called back

messages.content: One moment while I book that.
The callback could not be booked. Apologise and ask the caller to ring back during opening hours.
